files.role: exploratory paired spectral masks; not accepted event footprint

schema.valid_pair: bool HxW: both SCL4/5, DN>1 and finite NDVI
schema.change_candidate: bool HxW: valid_pair, preNDVI>0.4 postNDVI<0.3 delta<-0.3

observation_role: exploratory spectral proxy, not accepted event footprint
limitations: 47-day interval includes vegetation seasonality and unrelated processes
SCL and image registration errors unvalidated locally
routes/threshold selection are exploration, not independent model validation
Spatial agreement measured only on valid_pair; masked/unobservable pixels are not negative observations
Centerline and structure duplicates are not independent targets; repeated pixels are not independent events
For comparison, reproject model inundation to this 10m grid with nearest; this adds no model resolution, record 60m/120m support
